name: rote
description: Compile AI agent skills into cheap, fast, deterministic pipelines that run without an LLM in the loop

plugins.name: rote
plugins.description: Compile an AI agent skill into a deterministic workflow for DBOS, Temporal, Cloudflare Workflows, Inngest, or plain Python with /rote:compile, fill in its emitted stub modules with /rote:implement, then trigger the deployed workflows from Claude over MCP with /rote:serve.
